title: Work and a change show each count once, plain Now words and a real next step
description: A real browser on the built dashboard over the README's demo data (scripts/docs-media-demo.mjs) at 390 and 1280 px: on Work the In flight and Shipped today counts show only on their filters, not in the header line or the top strip; the top strip says 'shipped this week'; the Now column has no merge-writer or reviewer wording ('merge trial', 'latest main', 'diff and proofs'). On a change, the Now line does not repeat the state word beside the title, the Next line names an action (never a bare 'Mainworks (automatic)'), Details labels the priority picker 'Priority', and nothing scrolls sideways.

steps.name: Read Work and a change at 390 and 1280 px
